memoryTip: Multi + farious forms — many varied kinds at once.
correctPassage: Her multifarious interests range from botany to experimental music.
wrongPassages: Her multifarious interests were limited to a single hobby and nothing else.
The multifarious collection contained only one identical black shirt.
Please multifarious the chairs after lunch.

definition: arranged in layers; divided into status levels
memoryTip: In strata (layers) — stacked rock or stacked social ranks.
correctPassage: Access to care is stratified by income and geography.
wrongPassages: The town was perfectly stratified: every household earned the same wage.
They mixed the batter until it was stratified into one smooth, even blend.
A stratified seating chart put seniors and freshmen in the exact same rows.

definition: having real importance or a firm basis
memoryTip: Has substance — real weight and importance, not fluff.
correctPassage: The board asked for substantive changes, not cosmetic edits.
wrongPassages: The report was substantive: three bullet points and no evidence at all.
They called the empty apology substantive because it used nice stationery.
A substantive rewrite left every flawed claim untouched and added more filler.

memoryTip: A long step forward — or progress (“made great strides”).
correctPassage: Public health has made a significant stride against the disease.
wrongPassages: Progress stalled completely, yet they celebrated a major stride backward.
Her stride across the room was a series of tiny, hesitant shuffles.
Missing every deadline was considered a stride toward the product launch.

definition: proceeding gradually and subtly with harmful effects
memoryTip: In-side-ious: harm sneaks in from inside before you notice.
correctPassage: An insidious form of bias can creep into even careful studies.
wrongPassages: The threat was insidious: a siren blared and every risk was labeled in red.
His insidious honesty left no room for tricks or hidden motives.
They welcomed the insidious improvement that openly fixed every problem overnight.
